label: exploratory
description: PROBE-SEED-SPREAD: smoke-matrix cells (S1, S4; lambda 0, 0.5) at the planned run size (2000 items, 10 seeds, budgets 1 to 31, DELIB 6 to 30), seed entropy 0.
outcome: 40 runs, 0 excluded. Mean per-run simulation time 0.013 s (max 0.019 s) in a first dirty-tree run (total 0.73 s) and 0.051 s (max 0.149 s) in the committed clean-tree rerun at revision 9bfb9d3 (total 2.47 s including bootstrap summaries; the machine was shared with other sessions); peak RSS 88.0 MiB. Between-seed SD of Delta in non-baseline cells (budget > 1): MV 0.0065 to 0.0137 (median 0.0090), SEQ 0.0067 to 0.0179 (median 0.0103), CW 0.0057 to 0.0131, DELIB 0.0065 to 0.0128. With the largest MV/SEQ SD (0.0179) the 10-seed t half-width is 0.0128, above the protocol's 0.01 threshold; 15 seeds give 0.0099, 20 give 0.0084, 30 give 0.0067. Not a finding.
